h5BWyHp6unSxLoPpskILog.zh: 歐洲去(2025)年5月截至今年8月累計報告341例確定病例,其中近半數疫情集中於今年5月以後,病患以4歲以下嬰幼兒為多,報告病例以英國(474例)及荷蘭(106例)為多,近期比利時因受雞蛋污染影響,報告逾300例病例。歐洲食品安全局(EFSA)統計全歐每年約報告9.1萬例,估計每年醫療與生產力損失等經濟負擔達30億歐元,當局呼籲⺠眾外食時,應避免食用未熟肉類、雞蛋與未加熱消毒之乳製品。
h5BWyHp6unSxLoPpskILog.en: From May 2025 to August this year, Europe cumulatively reported 341 confirmed cases, nearly half of which occurred after May this year; most patients were infants and children under 4. The United Kingdom (474 cases) and the Netherlands (106 cases) reported the most. Recently, Belgium has reported more than 300 cases due to contaminated eggs. EFSA estimates that about 91,000 cases are reported across Europe each year, with an estimated annual economic burden, including healthcare and productivity losses, of €3 billion. Authorities advise people eating out to avoid undercooked meat, raw eggs and unpasteurised dairy products.

iw1z7K0j7F6qPHRAhx-a2A.zh: 歐洲今年截至9/3共15國累計報告1,086例本土病例,其中61例死亡(CFR:6%),病例數超過過去10年同期平均(736例),病例以義大利(516例)、希臘(284例)及西班牙(88例) 等國為多,荷蘭為2020年以來首次報告人類病例。另亦有持續報告鳥類及馬科動物群聚疫情,雖尚無跡象顯示疾病嚴重度增加,當局評估當前氣候條件有利於病媒蚊傳播,預期未來數週病例數仍將持續上升。
iw1z7K0j7F6qPHRAhx-a2A.en: As of 3 September this year, 15 European countries have cumulatively reported 1,086 locally acquired cases, including 61 deaths (CFR 6%). The case count exceeds the average of 736 for the same period over the past 10 years. Cases are concentrated in Italy (516), Greece (284) and Spain (88), among others; the Netherlands reported its first human case since 2020. Bird and equine cluster outbreaks continue to be reported. Although there is no sign that disease severity is increasing, authorities assess that current climatic conditions favour mosquito-borne transmission, and case numbers are expected to keep rising in the coming weeks.

_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

ZVUSl-BJ_A5pmKiM1wBo-w.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,自去(2025)年5月迄今年8月累計報告341例確定病例,其中至少34例住院,疫情自5月起顯著上升(新增152例),病患分布於英國(207例)、荷蘭(106例)、比利時(15例)、德國(6 例)等7國,英國研判疑感染源為進口雞蛋,荷蘭懷疑感染源為雞肉。全基因定序顯示,本次菌株與2025年於荷蘭通報之雞蛋與家禽疫情相關。
ZVUSl-BJ_A5pmKiM1wBo-w.en: Europe update: from May 2025 to August this year, 341 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, of which at least 34 were hospitalised. The outbreak has risen markedly since May (152 new cases), with patients distributed across seven countries, including the UK (207 cases), the Netherlands (106), Belgium (15) and Germany (6). The UK suspects imported eggs as the source of infection, and the Netherlands suspects chicken meat. Whole-genome sequencing shows that this strain is related to egg and poultry outbreaks reported in the Netherlands in 2025.

quhhCVgNYud1C9if8bpuug.zh: WHO更新「洪迪亞斯號」郵輪疫情資訊,截至5/30累計報告13例病例,其中3 例死亡(致死率為23%),報告病例中有11 例確診為漢他病毒安地斯型感染,2 例為可能病例,自WHO 前於5/13 公布疫情資訊以來,共新增3例包括加拿大、荷蘭及西班牙確診病例。截至5/22 已有逾600 名接觸者進行追蹤,其中53%為高風險接觸者。WHO評估此疫情事件對全球之風險為低。
quhhCVgNYud1C9if8bpuug.en: WHO has updated information on the outbreak linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship. As of 30 May, 13 cases had been reported cumulatively, including three deaths (CFR 23%). Of the reported cases, 11 were confirmed as Andes hantavirus infection and two were probable cases. Since WHO's previous update on 13 May, three new cases have been added, in Canada, the Netherlands and Spain. As of 22 May, more than 600 contacts had been traced, 53% of them high-risk contacts. WHO assesses the global risk from this event as low.

O71pd0CFVQ1JPBVw0bYlUA.zh: WHO更新MV Hondus郵輪疫情資訊,荷蘭確認1例新增病例,該名船員先前在特內里費島(Tenerife)下船後被遣返回荷蘭,刻正隔離中。目前總計有12例病例,其中3例死亡,自5月2日WHO首次接獲通報以來,迄未有新增死亡病例,另在30個國家,仍有超過600名接觸者正持續追蹤。
O71pd0CFVQ1JPBVw0bYlUA.en: WHO updated information on the MV Hondius cruise ship outbreak. The Netherlands confirmed one new case; this crew member had disembarked at Tenerife earlier, was repatriated to the Netherlands, and is now in isolation. There are currently 12 cases in total, including three deaths. Since WHO first received the report on 2 May, no new deaths have been reported. More than 600 contacts in 30 countries are still being followed up.

z9lmEAuvz8htAvaanzYfwQ.zh: 荷蘭籍國際郵輪「洪迪亞斯號」發生漢他病毒安地斯型群聚事件,船上共 147 人(86 名乘客及 61 名船員),含括 23 國國籍。截至 5/6 止,WHO 共掌握 8 例郵輪相關病例,其中 3 例死亡,8 例中有 3 例經確認為漢他病毒感染,且其中 2 例基因定序為安地斯病毒。WHO 研判本次群聚發生最可能情境為,指標病例於南美洲南錐體地區(阿根廷、智利等國)旅遊期間經環境暴露感染,於潛伏期內登船,隨後在船上透過與其長時間及密切接觸等,造成人際間傳播。WHO 綜合目前資訊,研判本事件在郵輪整體公共衛生風險為中、全球為低。ECDC 建議將全船人員視為密切接觸者,下船後須進行 6 週隔離與症狀監測。
z9lmEAuvz8htAvaanzYfwQ.en: A Dutch-flagged international cruise ship, the Hondius, has experienced an Andes-type hantavirus cluster. There were 147 people on board (86 passengers and 61 crew) of 23 nationalities. As of 6 May, WHO had identified eight cruise-related cases, three of them fatal. Of the eight cases, three were confirmed as hantavirus infection, and two of these were genome-sequenced as Andes virus. WHO considers the most likely scenario to be that the index case was infected through environmental exposure while travelling in the Southern Cone of South America (such as Argentina and Chile), boarded the ship during the incubation period, and then transmitted the virus to others on board through prolonged close contact. Based on current information, WHO assesses the public health risk on the cruise ship as moderate and the global risk as low. ECDC recommends that all people on board be treated as close contacts and undergo six weeks of quarantine and symptom monitoring after disembarkation.

0XNJobSdgm7bl0H_D43o-Q.zh: WHO更新懸掛荷蘭國旗的郵輪群聚事件,截至5/4累計報告2例確診及5例疑病例,其中3例死亡及1例重症。船上共147名人員(含括23個國籍),4/1從阿根廷出發,發病日介於4/6-28,目前郵輪停靠維德角近海,相關單位已展開後送、撤離及監測等措施。WHO表示過往於歐、亞的致死率(CFR)為 1-15%,而於美洲的致死率可達50%,並評估本事件對大眾風險為低。
0XNJobSdgm7bl0H_D43o-Q.en: WHO has updated information on the cruise ship flying the Dutch flag. As of 4 May, two confirmed cases and five suspected cases had been reported cumulatively, including three deaths and one severe case. There are 147 people on board (of 23 nationalities). The ship departed Argentina on 1 April, and onset dates ranged from 6 to 28 April. The ship is currently anchored off Cape Verde, and relevant authorities have initiated transfers, evacuations and monitoring. WHO states that the CFR historically reported in Europe and Asia is 1–15%, while in the Americas it can reach 50%, and assesses the risk to the public from this event as low.

1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:今年累計報告H5N1流感5例、H9N2流感12例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,303起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共15國於2026/3/11-4/30期間報告439起H5N1疫情,德國361起、智利18起、南韓14起、波蘭13起、泊爾7起、法國5起、美國/臺灣各4起、加拿大3起、丹麥/奧地利/挪威/荷蘭各2起、柬埔寨/義大利各1起。 南韓於2026/4/29報告4起H5N9疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計20州報告1,093起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州/威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/4/19-25共425個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/馬里蘭/麻薩諸塞州共11個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.en: Update. Human cases: this year, 5 H5N1, 12 H9N2 and 1 H10N3 human influenza cases have been reported cumulatively. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,303 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Fifteen countries reported 439 H5N1 outbreaks between 11 March and 30 April 2026: Germany 361, Chile 18, South Korea 14, Poland 13, Nepal 7, France 5, the United States and Taiwan four each, Canada 3, Denmark, Austria, Norway and the Netherlands two each, and Cambodia and Italy one each. South Korea reported four H5N9 outbreaks on 29 April 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 425 sampling sites during 19–25 April 2026, of which 11 sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Maryland and Massachusetts detected H5-positive results.

-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.zh: PAHO針對美洲區發布麻疹疫情警報,今(2026)年美洲區第1-3週共7國報告1,031例確定病例,分別為墨西哥(740例)、美國(171例)、加拿大(67例)、瓜地馬拉(41例)、玻利維亞(10例)、智利(1例)及烏拉圭(1例),較去(2025)年同期(23例)增加43倍,其中73%病患未接種疫苗,11%病患接種史不明,病例主要集中於青少年及青年族群中,另發病率以1歲以下嬰兒為高,其次為1-4歲及5-9歲兒童;去年該地區共計13國報告14,891例確定病例,2024年報告466例,近5年病例數持續增加,且多個國家持續出現疫情。PAHO呼籲各國加強流行病學監測、疫苗接種及緊急疫情防控措施,以阻斷疫情傳播。 歐洲去年共計30國報告7,655例病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(4,198例)、法國(877例)、荷蘭(534例)、義大利(529例)及西班牙(426例)為多,其中79.9%病患未接種疫苗,病例數以5歲以下年齡層為多(佔40%),ECDC表示去年病例數較2024年(逾3.5萬例)下降,惟仍約2023年病例數兩倍,由於麻疹感染人數通常於冬末春初達到高峰,呼籲民眾檢視自身已完成疫苗接種。 哈薩克今年1月報告1,951例確定病例,病例數以中北部阿斯塔納州(581例)、東南部江布爾州(339例)及東南部阿拉木圖市(317例)為多,其中79%病患未接種疫苗,當局表示拒絕接種疫苗為疫情爆發主因,當局呼籲家長確認孩童疫苗接種情形,並依照國家免疫計畫及時接種疫苗;該國西部阿克托別州疫情嚴峻,單月報告逾百名病例,以3歲以下年齡層為主,其中24例兒童住院治療中。
-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/30累計142國/地區報告17萬5千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%);今年截至11/30累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中206例死亡(CFR:0.41%)。 今年11月共計48國家/地區報告2,150 例新增確診病例,其中 5例死亡(CFR:0.27%),68%來自非洲地區,相較10月,歐洲區與西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。 非洲地區近6週(11/2–12/14)共計19 國通報1,435例確診病例,其中7 例死亡(CFR:0.5%),其中以剛果民主共和國(427例)、幾內亞(330例)、賴比瑞亞(176例)、肯亞(142例)及迦納(107例)為高,除賴比瑞亞外,其餘近期病例數呈下降趨勢,另剛果民主共和國多省同時流行Ia及Ib型,部分省分受安全情勢與人口流動影響監測能力,病例數有低估情形。 非洲以外地區,羅馬亞通報首例 Ib 型境外移入病例,病患為成年男性,於今年8月確診,曾至中國且具高風險行為,入境後即住院隔離,境內未發現接觸者,後續亦無通報病例;西班牙及荷蘭持續出現Ib型社區傳播;英國12/2通報1例境外移入病例,同時檢出Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之 MPXV 重組病毒株,病況為輕症,現階段對該重組病毒株之流行範圍仍缺乏足夠資訊。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源缺乏,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,惟對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 30 November 2025, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 175,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 467 deaths (CFR: 0.27%). In 2025 up to 30 November, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 206 deaths (CFR: 0.41%). In November 2025, 48 countries and areas reported 2,150 new confirmed cases, including 5 deaths (CFR: 0.27%); 68% came from the African Region. Compared with October, cases rose in the European and Western Pacific Regions and declined in other regions. In the African Region, over the past six weeks (2 November–14 December), 19 countries reported 1,435 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR: 0.5%). The highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (427), Guinea (330), Liberia (176), Kenya (142) and Ghana (107). Except for Liberia, recent case numbers have declined in these countries. In the DRC, multiple provinces are experiencing clade Ia and Ib simultaneously, and in some provinces surveillance capacity is affected by security conditions and population movement, so cases may be underestimated. Outside Africa, Romania reported its first imported clade Ib case, in an adult male diagnosed in August this year who had travelled to China and had high-risk behaviour. He was hospitalised in isolation on arrival, no contacts were identified domestically, and no further cases have been reported. Spain and the Netherlands continue to report clade Ib community transmission. On 2 December, the United Kingdom reported 1 imported case, in which a recombinant MPXV strain containing gene segments of both clade Ib and clade IIb was detected. The case was mild, and there is currently insufficient information on the spread of this recombinant strain. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are lacking, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because asymptomatic infections and cases among travellers to affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, but as moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), particularly those with non-fixed sexual partners. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete epidemiological investigation and contact tracing, and high-risk people are urged to get vaccinated.

q-MJ3R-fOOCDxmf2Mbm1Kw.zh: ECDC報告歐洲2024年發生6,558起食物相關疫情事件,累計報告6萬2,481例病例,其中3,336例住院、53例死亡,整體疫情較2023年上升。所有食物相關之疫情中以沙門氏菌感染症為大宗共1,238起疫情,通報案件以法國、荷蘭、西班牙及比利時為多,其中有65起群聚事件之影響人數超過百人,另諾羅病毒則引起631起疫情;經調查交叉污染與未經適當處理、加熱處理不足及廚師受感染為疫情常見原因,發生地以學校、幼稚園、餐廳或職場最常見。
q-MJ3R-fOOCDxmf2Mbm1Kw.en: The ECDC reported that Europe recorded 6,558 food-related outbreak events in 2024, with 62,481 cases cumulatively, 3,336 hospitalisations and 53 deaths; the overall situation was higher than in 2023. Salmonella infection accounted for the largest share of food-related outbreaks, with 1,238 outbreaks. Most notifications came from France, the Netherlands, Spain and Belgium. Of these outbreaks, 65 clusters affected more than 100 people. Norovirus caused 631 outbreaks. Investigations found that common causes were cross-contamination, inadequate processing, insufficient heating and infected food handlers. Outbreaks most often occurred in schools, kindergartens, restaurants or workplaces.

gSKbfuqVEVcdFoCrmU9GLA.zh: 全球自今年9/5解除PHEIC截至11/24(除非洲現有疫區外),累計報告43例Ib型病例(歐洲27例、東南亞5例、美洲4例、西太平洋3例、東地中海/非洲各2例),其中22例為MSM族群;4區署(美洲/歐洲/東南亞/西太平洋)報告24例本土病例,其餘為旅遊相關或其繼發病例。 荷蘭新增3例病例,自10/17報告首例截至11/24已累計9例Ib型病例,其中8例為MSM,6例有共同俱樂部之群聚事件;西班牙自9月截至11/24累計報告6例Ib病例,另新增2例報告為疑I型分支,且無相關旅遊史之病例;黎巴嫩及埃及於今年9-10月分別報告3例及1例病例,分支皆未明。
gSKbfuqVEVcdFoCrmU9GLA.en: Since the PHEIC was lifted on 5 September this year, as of 24 November (excluding existing outbreak areas in Africa), 43 clade Ib cases have been reported cumulatively: 27 in Europe, 5 in South-East Asia, 4 in the Americas, 3 in the Western Pacific, and 2 each in the Eastern Mediterranean and Africa. Of these, 22 were among MSM. Four regions (the Americas, Europe, South-East Asia and the Western Pacific) reported 24 local cases; the rest were travel-related or secondary cases. The Netherlands reported 3 new cases. Since its first case on 17 October, the Netherlands had recorded 9 clade Ib cases by 24 November, 8 of them among MSM, and 6 of these were linked to a shared club cluster. Spain reported 6 clade Ib cases cumulatively from September to 24 November, and 2 further newly reported cases were suspected clade I cases without relevant travel history. Lebanon and Egypt reported 3 and 1 cases respectively in September and October this year; clade is unknown.

K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/28累計142國/地區報告17萬2千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%)。 今年截至第48週累計99國/地區報告5萬1千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區4萬3千餘例、美洲區4,442例、歐洲區2,429例、西太平洋區1,479例、東南亞區154例及東地中海區46例。非洲、歐洲、西太平洋及中東區疫情下降;惟美洲及東南亞區病例數上升。  其他更新: 馬利西部庫利科羅11/24報告首例死亡病例,其餘資訊不明,當局已加強邊境監測並隔離疑病例。 評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注之公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源不足,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,但對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
K9ssijP-lRta8C7CLnSU4g.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 28 November this year, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 172,000 confirmed cases globally, of which at least 467 died (CFR 0.27%). Year to date as of week 48, 99 countries and areas have reported more than 51,000 confirmed cases: more than 43,000 in the African Region, 4,442 in the Region of the Americas, 2,429 in the European Region, 1,479 in the Western Pacific Region, 154 in the South-East Asia Region and 46 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have declined in the African, European, Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean regions, but risen in the Americas and South-East Asia. Other updates: In Koulikoro, western Mali, the first death was reported on 24 November; other information is unknown. Authorities have strengthened border surveillance and isolated suspected cases. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are inadequate, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because cases among asymptomatic infected people and travelers from affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The assessed risk to the general public is low, but moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), especially those without a stable sexual partner. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete contact tracing, and high-risk individuals are urged to get vaccinated.

frQE8nORRtTZ99K-99v--Q.zh: 荷蘭自10/17報告首例Ib型病例,截至11/6已累計報告6例Ib型病例,病患近期皆無旅遊史,惟於10月某日曾共同造訪以MSM族群為主之俱樂部,當局呼籲高風險者可接種疫苗,以預防感染並減輕疾病負擔。
frQE8nORRtTZ99K-99v--Q.en: The Netherlands reported its first clade Ib case on 17 October. As of 6 November, six clade Ib cases had been reported cumulatively. The patients had no recent travel history, but on a day in October some of them visited together a club mainly frequented by MSM. Authorities urge high-risk individuals to get vaccinated to prevent infection and reduce the disease burden.

TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.zh: 希臘11/1報告該國首例Ib型境外移入病例,該病患曾具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,並發生MSM行為。歐洲6國於10/11-20期間報告至少8例I型病例,分別為德國/義大利各2例、比利時/荷蘭/葡萄牙/西班牙各1例,其中2例不具旅遊史,其中3例為MSM族群,顯示可能在同性/雙性族群中尚有未發現的社交傳播鏈。當局評估MSM族群傳播風險為中,一般民眾為低。 英國自2022年截至今年10/31已累計3,732例病例,其中,累計18例Ib型病例,大多數病例與前往Ib型流行國家有直/間接關聯,該國於11/3新增報告1例Ib型病例,即具泰國旅遊史。由於近期歐、美洲MSM族群傳播風險升高,當局評估將該病輸入傳播風險從中提升至高。
TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.en: Greece reported on 1 November its first imported clade Ib case; the patient had a travel history to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and had engaged in MSM behaviour. Between 11 and 20 October, six European countries reported at least eight clade Ib cases: Germany and Italy 2 each, and Belgium, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain 1 each. Two of these cases had no travel history, and three were in the MSM population, suggesting that undetected social transmission chains may exist among men who have sex with men and bisexual populations. Authorities assess the transmission risk in the MSM population as moderate and for the general public as low. The United Kingdom has recorded 3,732 cases cumulatively since 2022 as of 31 October this year, including 18 clade Ib cases, most of which are directly or indirectly linked to travel to countries with clade Ib transmission. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 3 November, with a travel history to Thailand. Because the transmission risk among MSM in Europe and the Americas has recently increased, authorities have raised the assessed risk of importation and spread from moderate to high.

Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.zh: 法國自6月截至8/13累積報告18例病例,其中2例死亡,病患年齡介於34-95歲間,比利時、丹麥、荷蘭、挪威亦檢出相關案例;當局已下架疑感染源(牛/羊奶起司),惟該產品已銷往全球32個國家/地區,包含鄰近之香港、日本及韓國。
Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.en: France has reported 18 cases since June, as of 13 August, of which 2 died; patients are aged 34–95 years. Related cases have also been detected in Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway. Authorities have withdrawn the suspected source, a cheese made from cow's and sheep's milk, but the product has been sold to 32 countries and regions, including neighbouring Hong Kong, Japan and South Korea.

0vyPBSg9CJyF4xa0r4Rhsw.zh: 蒙古疫情嚴峻,今年截至6/12累計報告逾6,500例及6例死亡,該國僅近3週新增已超過3,600例,此波疫情主要影響未接種疫苗之學齡兒童,多數病例發生於10-14歲年齡層,由於疫情快速蔓延且接觸者眾多,尤其在首都烏蘭巴托等人口密集處,構成持續傳播風險。 荷蘭報告1例死亡病例,病患為具免疫系統相關疾病之成年人,於5月下旬住院,感染源仍不明。該國今年截至6/4累計報告437例,其中50例為境外移入,多數病例為境外移入個案及相關接觸者,目前皆為小規模群聚,尚未發生全國性疫情,該國上次發生大規模疫情為2013-14年。
0vyPBSg9CJyF4xa0r4Rhsw.en: Mongolia's outbreak is severe. As of 12 June this year, more than 6,500 cases and 6 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with more than 3,600 of the cases added in just the past three weeks. The outbreak mainly affects unvaccinated school-age children, with most cases aged 10–14. Because the outbreak is spreading rapidly and there are many contacts, especially in densely populated areas such as the capital, Ulaanbaatar, it poses a continuing risk of transmission. The Netherlands reported one death, an adult with an immune-system-related disease who was hospitalized in late May; the source of infection remains unknown. The country has reported 437 cumulative cases this year as of 4 June, 50 of them imported. Most are imported cases and their contacts, and currently these are small clusters; no nationwide outbreak has occurred. The country's last large-scale outbreak was in 2013–14.

64D5XtZGfsUtOk7sQk9LSA.zh: 中國疫情持續,今年3月報告1,919例病例,較1、2月(月增約2,200例)下降,惟仍高於去年同期(1,624例);日本今年截至4/13累計報告42例病例,高於去年同期(28例);韓國今年截至4/24累計報告377例病例,與去年同期(381例)相當。 荷蘭於3月中旬報告24例病例,其中8例住院,病患發病日介於去(2024)年11月至今年2月,經當局調查疑感染源為超市的冷凍藍莓並提醒民眾不要食用該批產品。
64D5XtZGfsUtOk7sQk9LSA.en: China's outbreak continues: 1,919 cases were reported in March this year, down from January and February (a monthly increase of about 2,200 cases), but still higher than the same period last year (1,624 cases). Japan reported 42 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, higher than the 28 cases in the same period last year. South Korea reported 377 cases cumulatively this year as of 24 April, comparable to the 381 cases in the same period last year. The Netherlands reported 24 cases in mid-March, 8 of whom were hospitalized. The patients had onset between November 2024 and February this year. Investigation suggests the suspected source was frozen blueberries sold at supermarkets, and the public has been advised not to eat that batch of product.

9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.zh: 歐洲3/6報告,自2023/1-2025/1期間,累計9個國家/區509例病,分別為挪威(257例)、瑞典(110)、芬蘭(94)、德國(30)、荷蘭(9)、丹麥(4)、法國(3)、比利時(1)、愛沙亞(1)。多國調查皆認為感染源為義大利某產地之苜蓿芽,基因定序亦有相同結論,當局已實施相關介入措施,以防止受汙染產品進入市場。
9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.en: Europe reported on 6 March that, between January 2023 and January 2025, 509 cases had been reported cumulatively in 9 countries: Norway 257, Sweden 110, Finland 94, Germany 30, the Netherlands 9, Denmark 4, France 3, Belgium 1 and Estonia 1. Investigations in several countries concluded that the source was alfalfa sprouts from a production site in Italy, and genetic sequencing reached the same conclusion. Authorities have implemented relevant interventions to prevent contaminated products from entering the market.

7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.zh: 全球疫情嚴峻:  非洲:今年迄今累計7國報告2.1萬餘例疑病例,其中確診3,600餘例及54例死亡,病例集中於摩洛哥,今年迄今報告超過2萬例及37例死亡。 歐洲:ECDC更新2025年1月麻疹資訊,17國報告1,033例,其中以羅馬亞663例為多,其次為義大利74例及西班牙70例,餘14國報告病例數為1-67例。歐盟多國仍持續發生疫情,去年病例數遽增,全年報告3.2萬餘例,其中19例死亡,ECDC表示依據疾病季節模式,評估今年春季病例數將持續增加。因歐洲多數國家皆未達到完整接種之水準,呼籲各國應積極接種。荷蘭今年迄2月累計報告63例,多數病例為境外移入及其接觸者,境外移入病例多來自摩洛哥及羅馬亞。 亞洲:越南河內市近1週(2/28-3/7)新增120例,今年迄今累計報告745例,去年同期則無報告病例;日本第9週(2/27-3/5)新增4例,為今年以來新高,該國累計報告9例,多為境外移入,近期千葉縣及埼玉縣各報告1例自越南移入個案。 美洲:美國德州及新墨西哥州疫情持續,今年截至3/11累計報告256例(德州223例),其中30例住院,2例死亡;加州洛杉磯郡報告今年首例,病患具臺灣旅遊史,於3/5返國,目前相關單位調查中。美洲地區今年截至2/21,共4國報告268例,顯著高於去年同期之60例。
7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.en: Global outbreaks remain severe. Africa: so far this year, 7 countries have reported over 21,000 suspected cases, including over 3,600 confirmed and 54 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Morocco, which has reported over 20,000 cases and 37 deaths this year. Europe: ECDC has updated its measles data for January 2025. 17 countries reported 1,033 cases, of which Romania had 663, followed by Italy with 74 and Spain with 70; the remaining 14 countries reported 1–67 cases each. Several EU countries continue to have outbreaks. Cases surged last year, with over 32,000 reported for the full year, 19 of them fatal. ECDC says that based on seasonal patterns, case numbers are expected to keep rising this spring. Because most European countries have not reached full vaccination levels, it calls on countries to vaccinate actively. The Netherlands reported 63 cases so far this year up to February; most were imported cases and their contacts, mainly from Morocco and Romania. Asia: Hanoi, Viet Nam, added 120 cases in the past week (28 February–7 March), with 745 cases reported so far this year and none in the same period last year. Japan added 4 cases in week 9 (27 February–5 March), the highest this year; it has reported 9 cases cumulatively, mostly imported, and recently one imported case each from Viet Nam was reported in Chiba and Saitama prefectures. Americas: outbreaks continue in Texas and New Mexico, USA; as of 11 March, 256 cases had been reported this year (223 in Texas), of which 30 were hospitalized and 2 died. Los Angeles County reported its first case this year, in a patient with a travel history to Taiwan who returned on 5 March; investigation is ongoing. As of 21 February, 4 countries in the Americas had reported 268 cases this year, well above the 60 in the same period last year.

JnaKcCoFR_36KooLFEVHOw.zh: 歐洲報告自今年1月截至2/6,檢測出有相同基因關聯的菌株(Shigella sonnei ST152)聚集,顯示有相同的感染來源,分別為英國報告20例、奧地利/法國均為7例、荷蘭1例,其中27例有國際旅遊史,主要於亞洲國家旅行。病患介於15-70歲,多數為女性。發病期間為1/8-17,感染源仍不明,ECDC評估可能有國際間旅行傳播的可能性。
JnaKcCoFR_36KooLFEVHOw.en: From January to 6 February, Europe detected a cluster of strains with the same genetic link (Shigella sonnei ST152), indicating a common source of infection: the UK reported 20 cases, Austria and France 7 each, and the Netherlands 1. Among them, 27 cases had an international travel history, mainly to Asian countries. Patients were aged 15–70, and most were women. Illness onset was between 8 and 17 January. The source of infection remains unknown, and the ECDC assesses that transmission linked to international travel is possible.
